messages:
maya: FYI onboarding run for tangelo-7b-v1 is tripping KV cache mismatches on runtime-2.3. Repro steps below.

liam: Looking. Do you have a minimal repro and which seq_len?

maya: seq_len=2048, batch=2. Observed that after layer 10 keys shift — attention is reading wrong past tokens.

ram: I reproduced locally. Command I used:
```bash
python tests/replicate_kv_bug.py --model tangelo-7b-v1 --seq 2048 --use-kv-cache
```
Output shows attention scores spike then decay to zeros after layer 10.

ops-bot: [deploy] canary runtime-2.3-c2 created for team=eng-ml (id=c2-20260315-09).

jen: Stack trace/snippet from runtime logs:
```
RuntimeException: kv_index_mismatch at attention.cpp:422
  at rotary_apply_scale(sincos_ptr, pos, head_dim)
  at compute_attn_scores(layer=11, seq=2048)
```
Seems tied to RoPE scaling.

aiden: Quick datapoint: I ran a quantized q4_0 pass; logits look okay but attention patterns diverge vs fp16 starting at the same layer. Think it's RoPE layout vs kernel expectation.

liam: This smells like a rotary implementation mismatch between our compilation kernels and the model's positional encoding variant. Two immediate mitigations: 1) fallback to legacy rope scaling in runtime; 2) disable KV prefix caching. Both hurt perf.

maya: For an immediate canary I prefer 1) add a compatibility flag so we can enable for tangelo only. We'll measure perf delta.

liam: Opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/eng-runtime/pull/1423 — adds `runtime.flags.rope_scale_legacy` and conditional sincos loader. Patch briefly: 
```diff
+ if (model.meta.rope_variant == "legacy") runtime.flags.rope_scale_legacy = true;
```
Benchmarks locally: latency +2.1% but fixes attention alignment.

ram: I'll add a regression test to the harness: `tests/kv_rope_regression.py` that runs short-context replay and diffs attention maps. Snippet:
```python
def test_kv_rope_alignment():
    out_ref = run_model("tangelo-7b-v1", seq=512, kv_off=False, use_legacy_rope=False)
    out_new = run_model("tangelo-7b-v1", seq=512, kv_off=False, use_legacy_rope=True)
    assert attn_diff(out_ref, out_new) < 1e-3
```

jen: Also adding a small unit to CI that runs the quantized kernels (q4_0 and int8) for the model to catch this earlier.

aiden: I kicked off a small eval suite against our internal promptset + HELM subset. Preliminary numbers: WikiText ppl +0.18 (worse) but summarization rouge drops ~1.6 on one config if we naively enable legacy rope. Need fine-grained compare.

maya: Noted. So owners: liam/runtime (PR + canary), aiden/evals (compare metric matrix + quant runs), ram/repro + tests, jen/CI updates.

liam: Plan: merge PR behind feature-flag, roll canary tomorrow 10:00 PST to canary runtime-c2, run eval harness, if green promote to canary-dedicated.

ram: I'll prepare a small script to flip `model.meta.rope_variant` during model ingestion to mark tangelo-7b-v1 as legacy.

maya: Great. Also logging: add debug dump of sincos arrays to S3 for failing runs (short-lived). Helps narrow exact layout mismatch.

ops-bot: [reminder] scheduled canary rollout at 2026-03-16T18:00Z (10:00 PST). Assigned owners: liam, aiden, ram, jen.

jen: quick note — add to onboarding intake checklist: "specify RoPE variant (standard/legacy/custom)" and "run KV replay test at seq 2048".

maya: thanks team. tagging this thread for the onboarding doc update and follow-ups. :thumbsup:
